source.scope: release working tree before version bump

suites.name: UI with local HTTP response fixtures
suites.backend: mock responses; production HTML, CSS and JavaScript
coverage: All six sortable columns in both directions; server query parameters and persisted page size.
Direct source/cloud links, conditional status menus, keyboard focus and disabled actions.
Unknown storage modes, same/alternate cloud paths, failed files retained in quota.
Frozen progress, single-line task rows, overview totals and activity state priority.
Five export filters, four selectable fields, TXT/CSV options and native browser download.
Quota warnings gated by manual completed verified scans; automatic/scheduled scans suppressed.
Desktop/mobile layout and safe text/URL rendering.

suites.name: UI with production controller and temporary SQLite
suites.backend: WebApplication and WebService through local threaded WSGI; real queue, runner, inventory and export code
replaced_boundaries: Mail login uses offline test tokens.
Cloud transport, quota, metadata and byte transfer use FakeCloud from tests/test_runner.py with controlled pause fixtures.
coverage: Panel password setup, logout/login, session cookie and CSRF-protected actions.
Cyrillic source registration, six synthetic media tasks and complete cloud reconciliation.
Exact/alternate cloud matches with separate storage totals and only one new quota candidate.
Six sorts, page-size selection, manual skip and return without uploading.
Authenticated JPEG preview and Unicode M4V download.
Individual unlimited photo upload and ordinary M4V upload without false metadata error.
Task pause checkpoint and saved authorization survive WebApplication/WebService reinitialization.
Paused task resumes; real CSV export has UTF-8 BOM and quotes a delimiter inside a filename.
Fresh scans replace task IDs, requeue deleted cloud objects and match renamed local files without duplicate tasks.

limitations: No live Mail account, actual cloud quota or real media eligibility was tested; media and credentials were synthetic.
Restart coverage reinitializes WebApplication and WebService with persisted temporary state; it does not restart a Docker container or a NAS.
The working tree was tested before its version constant was updated; this report does not validate a published container image.
